verdict.rationale: Viam's official CLI documents data export "in a variety of formats" and SQL queries with an output destination, so a user can pull captured data out. The docs do not name which formats are used or whether they are open, and nothing shows that everything (configs, models, datasets) can be exported for full portability. missing for 10: named open export formats, evidence of complete export of all data types (configs, ML models, datasets, binary data), a documented offboarding or account-exit path, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: With it, you can export data in a variety of formats, query tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL, delete data
viam data query tabular sql --org-id=<org-id> --sql=<query> [--destination=<output path>]
